name: lowelllab/hyperf-dpop
description: Hyperf integration for strict DPoP authentication, nonce and atomic replay protection.

suggest.hyperf/redis: Required by the default shared admission budget and the optional Redis replay store.
suggest.hyperf/command: Required for the read-only dpop:doctor command.
suggest.hyperf/devtool: Provides vendor:publish for configuration and opt-in DDL templates.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required by the default MySQL replay store.
